description: ROBINE-AT-Energy: Hourly electricity demand and supply profiles for the historical climate period and for global warming levels of 2 °C, 3 °C, and 4 °C in Austria at the NUTS-3 level is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Demet Suna, Peter Widhalm (AIT Austrian Institute Of Technology - Center for Energy). As energy systems increasingly rely on variable renewable energy sources (VRES), their vulnerability to weather conditions grows, leading to greater uncertainty for the future. Climate change further intensifies these challenges by affecting both energy supply and demand. Coverage: global (AT); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
